Priya Nair: Heads-up — prepping CrestWave QBR next Tue. Need final token econ + 90-day spend forecast. Onboarding still in progress (post-auth flows), renewal in ~45 days. Can ops + enablement weigh in?
Alex Chen: I can pull a forecast by EOD. Noticed an embed-heavy burst tied to their staging keys — might be skewing daily averages.
cost-insights-bot: Alert: CrestWave daily spend spike +42% vs baseline yesterday. Details: https://redwood.app/costs/crestwave/report/1719998888
Jordan Patel: Onboarding update — 3/5 milestones complete. SSO is pending and blocking production sign-offs. Customer feedback: wants clearer token limits, pre-prod guardrails, and a simple per-route cost view.
Priya Nair: Ok — so SSO is the major renewal risk. Jordan, can you capture the exact ask for limits & example traffic from their eng lead?
Jordan Patel: Yep — just messaged their eng lead (cc @alex). Expecting a snippet of their traffic profile by tomorrow afternoon.
Liam O'Connor: For the QBR slides I'll need: projected monthly tokens (committed vs observed), per-route token breakdown, recommended commit to reduce overage risk, and a suggested burst policy. I can draft once Alex shares numbers.
Alex Chen: Forecast CSV uploaded: https://redwood.app/drive/crestwave/forecast_1719998888.csv — includes per-route, embedding vs generation tokens, and a short sim. Note: enabling prefix/KV caching could reduce token rate ~18% on their top routes.
Priya Nair: Great. Also capture feedback: they asked for tenant-level alerts and clearer attribution for embeddings costs — add that to the enablement backlog.
Jordan Patel: Scheduling an enablement + ops sync Fri 10am PT. Sending calendar invite now.
Priya Nair: Action owners: Alex = forecast & cost sim, Liam = QBR slides, Jordan = SSO status & customer feedback capture, Priya = renewal risk note + exec summary.
Alex Chen: Ack — I'll flag if forecast changes after I filter out staging noise.
cost-insights-bot: Budget alert config: {"budget_threshold":"80%","current_usage":"67%","window":"30d"} — no overrun yet.
Priya Nair: Closing loop — I'll update the QBR tracker and share a draft by Monday. Please drop any customer quotes or screenshots into the tracker. :thumbsup:
